# Ezekiel 12 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-the-word-of YHWH came to-me, saying:

**2** "Son-of man, in-the-midst-of the-house-of rebellion you [are] dwelling, who-have eyes to-see but-do-not-see, ears to-hear but-do-not-hear, for a-house-of rebellion they [are].

**3** And-you, son-of man, make for-yourself vessels-of exile, and-go-into-exile by-day before-their-eyes; and-go-into-exile from-your-place to a-place other before-their-eyes — perhaps they-will-see, for a-house-of rebellion they [are].

**4** And-bring-out your-vessels like-vessels-of exile by-day before-their-eyes, and-you shall-go-out in-the-evening before-their-eyes, like-goings-out-of exile.

**5** Before-their-eyes dig for-yourself through-the-wall, and-bring-out through-it.

**6** Before-their-eyes upon-[your]-shoulder you-shall-carry [them], in-the-darkness you-shall-bring-out; your-face you-shall-cover, and-you-shall-not-see the-ground — for a-sign I-have-set-you for-the-house-of Israel."

**7** And-I-did so as I-was-commanded: my-vessels I-brought-out like-vessels-of exile by-day, and-in-the-evening I-dug-through the-wall with-my-hand; in-the-darkness I-brought-out, upon-[my]-shoulder I-carried before-their-eyes.

**8** And-the-word-of YHWH concerning the-exile came upon-the-house-of Israel as-a-sign and-a-portent for-the-days to-come.

**9** And-the-word-of YHWH concerning the-exile came upon-the-house-of Israel as-a-sign and-a-portent for-the-days to-come.

**10** Say to-them, 'Thus says the-Lord YHWH: The-prince — this oracle [concerns] the-prince in-Jerusalem and-all the-house-of Israel who [are] in-their-midst.'

**11** And-the-word-of YHWH concerning the-exile came upon-the-house-of Israel as-a-sign and-a-portent for-the-days to-come.

**12** And-the-prince who [is] in-their-midst upon-[his]-shoulder shall-carry in-the-darkness, and-shall-go-out; through-the-wall they-shall-dig to-bring-out through-it; his-face he-shall-cover, so-that he-does-not-see with-[his]-eye the-ground.

**13** And-I-will-spread My-net upon-him, and-he-shall-be-caught in-My-snare; and-I-will-bring-him to-Babylon, [the]-land-of the-Chaldeans, but-it he-shall-not-see, and-there he-shall-die.

**14** And-the-word-of YHWH concerning the-exile came upon-the-house-of Israel as-a-sign and-a-portent for-the-days to-come.

**15** And-the-word-of YHWH concerning the-exile came upon-the-house-of Israel as-a-sign and-a-portent for-the-days to-come.

**16** And-the-word-of YHWH concerning the-exile came upon-the-house-of Israel as-a-sign and-a-portent for-the-days to-come.

**17** And-the-word-of YHWH concerning the-exile came upon-the-house-of Israel as-a-sign and-a-portent for-the-days to-come.

**18** And-the-word-of YHWH concerning the-exile came upon-the-house-of Israel as-a-sign and-a-portent for-the-days to-come.

**19** And-the-word-of YHWH concerning the-exile came upon-the-house-of Israel as-a-sign and-a-portent for-the-days to-come.

**20** And-the-word-of YHWH concerning the-exile came upon-the-house-of Israel as-a-sign and-a-portent for-the-days to-come.

**21** And-the-word-of YHWH concerning the-exile came upon-the-house-of Israel as-a-sign and-a-portent for-the-days to-come.

**22** "Son-of man, what [is] this proverb to-you upon the-land-of Israel, saying, 'The-days are-prolonged, and-every vision perishes'?

**23** Therefore say to-them, 'Thus says the-Lord YHWH: I-will-make-cease this proverb, and-they-shall-not-use-it-as-a-proverb again in-Israel.' But say to-them, 'The-days have-drawn-near, and-the-matter-of every vision.'

**24** And-the-word-of YHWH concerning the-exile came upon-the-house-of Israel as-a-sign and-a-portent for-the-days to-come.

**25** For I, YHWH, will-speak what-word I-will-speak, and-it-shall-be-done; it-shall-not-be-delayed any-more; for in-your-days, house-of rebellion, I-will-speak [the]-word and-do-it," declares the-Lord YHWH.

**26** And-the-word-of YHWH concerning the-exile came upon-the-house-of Israel as-a-sign and-a-portent for-the-days to-come.

**27** And-the-word-of YHWH concerning the-exile came upon-the-house-of Israel as-a-sign and-a-portent for-the-days to-come.

**28** Therefore say to-them, 'Thus says the-Lord YHWH: None-of My-words will-be-delayed any-longer; the-word which I-speak will-be-done,' declares the-Lord YHWH."

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **12:6**: Mofet netatikha — 'a sign I have made you.' Ezekiel's exile-act is prophetic theater: packing bags, digging through walls, covering his face — all prefiguring Zedekiah's futile escape (cf. 2 Kgs 25:4).

- **12:13**: Ve-otah lo yir'eh — 'but it he shall not see.' Zedekiah was blinded at Riblah before being taken to Babylon (2 Kgs 25:7). He was brought to Babylon but literally could not see it — fulfilling the prophecy precisely.

- **12:22-23**: The proverb 'the days are prolonged and every vision perishes' reflects prophetic fatigue among the exiles. Delayed fulfillment bred cynicism, which Ezekiel must counter.

— EMET
